mainEntity.name: What documents do I need for permit coordination and inspections?

acceptedAnswer.text: The most important evidence is a complete permit application package: project address, record or permit number, scope details, and any plans or supporting documents the city requests. Denver also lets users download approved plans and view inspection results in e-permits once the record is active.
acceptedAnswer.description: Have your site address, permit number if available, project scope, and required plans ready. If the city requests corrections, keep the revised documents organized so resubmittals are faster.
